typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		name as string,
		{activate date} as date,
		{last activity} as string,
		{card number} as string,
		{access list} as string,
		active as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(DerivedCol1 = $FileName,
		IsBlankRow = iif((isNull(name) || trim(name) == ''), 1, 0)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn split(IsBlankRow == 0,IsBlankRow == 1, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Process,DontProcess,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Process sink(input(
		CardNumber as string,
		Active as string,
		ActivateDate as string,
		Fname as string,
		LastActivity as string,
		AccessList as string,
		Name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CardNumber = {card number},
		Active = active,
		ActivateDate = {activate date},
		Fname = DerivedCol1,
		LastActivity = {last activity},
		AccessList = {access list},
		Name = name),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
